name: chatgpt:auth
description: Initialize or refresh local authentication for chatgpt.com; use on fresh clones or expired sessions.

name: chatgpt:api
description: Inspect endpoints, inherited parameter groups, and reusable API execution for chatgpt.com.

name: chatgpt:browse
description: Operate chatgpt.com directly in the logged-in browser when UI mode is requested or API is gated by CAPTCHA.

name: chatgpt:search-history
description: Search existing conversations on chatgpt.com via the search modal UI or observed backend API without sending a new chat prompt.

name: chatgpt:api-search-history
description: Execute "Search conversation history" via chatgpt.com API using local auth/cookies; fallback to browser on CAPTCHA or expired session.

name: chatgpt:browser-search-history
description: Execute "Search conversation history" via chatgpt.com browser UI; use when CAPTCHA is required, API is unverified, or UI is requested.

name: chatgpt:project
description: Route chatgpt.com tasks between reusable local API execution and browser UI workflows.
